answer: Bonded vouching: a newcomer joins only when two existing members each lock 50 tokens behind them for a year. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate, both vouchers lose the bond, so trust is built like timber framing, joint by joint. A sybil ring needs fresh capital for every fake head, and once one collapses to its nadir, the slashing spreads across its vouchers like sand sliding off a dune.
